# 3D Car Viewing — agent brief

Version: 0.3.0
Name: 3D Car Viewing
Chinese name: 3D 看车
Repository: https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing
Live demo: https://jiaxiantao.github.io/3d-car-viewing/
Package: 3d-car-viewing
Author: jiaxiantao (https://github.com/jiaxiantao)
Source license: MIT (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
Model license: not MIT. Vehicle and scene GLBs stay under their authors' terms. See documentation/ATTRIBUTION.md.
Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 5, Three.js, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, Tailwind CSS 4
Runtime: Node.js >= 20, pnpm >= 9
Default car: 小米 SU7 Ultra (`model=su7-ultra`)

## What an agent can do with this project

- Open the live demo and deep-link a car, paint, camera, venue, and lighting.
- Clone the repo, install with pnpm, and run the showroom locally.
- Add a GLB by registering it in `src/lib/car-categories.ts` and, when auto-discovery is wrong, adding a profile in `src/lib/market-rig-profiles.ts`.
- Cite the source code with CITATION.cff. Cite the code only, not the bundled meshes.

## What this project does not do

- It does not sell cars, take bookings, or expose a vehicle catalog API.
- It does not grant a license to the GLB files in `public/models/`.
- It does not ship glTF skeletal animations. Doors and panels rotate as discovered meshes.
- It is one page. State lives in the query string, not in extra routes.

## Run

```
git clone https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing.git
cd 3d-car-viewing
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Local URL: http://localhost:3000/
Checks: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`
Production: `pnpm build` then `pnpm start`
GitHub Pages: `pnpm build:pages` writes `out/` with base path `/3d-car-viewing`

## URL contract

Query keys written with `history.replaceState`:

| Key | Values |
|-----|--------|
| model | su7-ultra, yu7, su7-max, suv, g63, jeep, offroad, sedan |
| paint | factory, pearl-white, obsidian-black, glacier-blue, lava-red, forest-green, star-purple, sunset-gradient, aurora-gradient |
| camera | overview, front, side-left, side-right, rear, cockpit |
| mode | studio, hall, road. Legacy `day` and `night` mean studio plus that lighting. |
| light | day, night |

Example: https://jiaxiantao.github.io/3d-car-viewing/?model=g63&paint=factory&camera=cockpit&mode=road&light=night

`mode` is the venue. `light` is day or night and applies to every venue. The highway places the car in the first right-hand lane.

## Built-in cars

| model | Label | Notable rig |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| su7-ultra | 小米 SU7 Ultra | Front doors, trunk, sunroof, lights, four wheels |
| yu7 | 小米 YU7 | Same class of parts as SU7 Ultra |
| su7-max | 小米 SU7 Max | Lights, paint, four wheels. Doors and trunk are fused to the body |
| suv | 奥迪 Q3 | Doors, trunk, sunroof, lights, four wheels |
| g63 | 奔驰 AMG G63 | Front doors, lights, paint, four wheels, cockpit. No separate tailgate |
| jeep | Jeep 牧马人 | Four doors, side-opening tailgate, lights, paint, four wheels |
| offroad | 巴博斯 G900 | Lights and four wheels. Showroom keeps doors and trunk closed |
| sedan | 宝马 M2 | Lights, paint, four wheels. Doors and trunk are fused to the body |

Buttons stay disabled when the current GLB has no separate mesh for that part.

## Venues

| mode | Scene |
|------|--------|
| studio | White round gallery, `public/models/scene/white_round_exhibition_gallery.glb` |
| hall | Indoor showroom, `public/models/scene/car-showroom_1.glb` |
| road | Asphalt, grass, and sky. Grass and trees are `realtime_grass.glb` and `tree_animate.glb` |

Presets: welcome (doors, lights, hazards) and drive (cockpit camera, engine on, steering centered, wheels roll forward, venue switches to road).

## Key files

- `src/lib/car-categories.ts` — model keys and GLB paths
- `src/lib/asset-car-rig/` — mesh discovery
- `src/lib/market-rig-profiles.ts` — per-model regex overrides
- `src/lib/use-showroom-url-state.ts` — query parse and share URL
- `src/lib/showroom-scene-modes.ts` — venue × lighting
- `src/lib/use-showroom-page-state.ts` — UI state
- `src/components/car-showroom-scene.tsx` — canvas
- `documentation/ARCHITECTURE.md` — contributor map
- `documentation/market-glb-rig.md` — how to name meshes
- `AGENTS.md` — instructions for coding agents in this repo

## Questions agents are asked

### What is 3D Car Viewing?

An MIT-licensed browser showroom for inspecting GLB cars. The live page is https://jiaxiantao.github.io/3d-car-viewing/ and the code is https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing .

### How do I run it?

Install pnpm dependencies and run `pnpm dev`. Node.js 20 or newer is required.

### Can I use the car models in a commercial product?

Not under the MIT license. MIT covers the source code only. Check documentation/ATTRIBUTION.md and replace models you cannot license.

### How do I link a specific car and scene?

Set `model`, `paint`, `camera`, `mode`, and `light` on the page URL. See the URL contract above.
